title: AI vs. Human Judgment of Content Moderation: LLM-as-a-Judge and Ethics-Based Response Refusals

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing pairwise win/loss/tie rates of ethical and technical response refusals evaluated by human users (using Chatbot Arena data) versus LLM-as-a-Judge systems (GPT-4o and Llama 3 70B), utilizing OLS regressions to quantify the systematic preference of models for alignment-signaling refusal behaviors.
